events.verdict: Hardaway Jr. (DEN) cuts in front of Johnson (ATL) during his driving shot attempt swiping at the ball, but avoids making any contact.
Porzingis (ATL) brings his arm toward Jokic's (DEN) path and marginal contact occurs at the start of Jokic's (DEN) drive.
Porzingis (ATL) drifts toward Jokic (DEN) when marginal body contact occurs during his driving shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) places a hand on Johnson (ATL), causing marginal contact to occur before he picks up his dribble at the end of the drive.
Jokic (DEN) legally contests Alexander-Walker's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Porzingis (ATL) initially absorbs the body contact before marginal contact occurs with Jokic (DEN) during the drive.
Johnson (ATL) contests Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt when marginal contact occurs after Jokic's release.
Krejci (ATL) legally contests Johnson's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) and Porzingis (ATL) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball.
Porzingis (ATL) brings his hands towards Brown (DEN) as he releases away, and the contact during the pick is marginal.
Murray (DEN) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Porzingis (ATL) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Johnson (ATL) commits a take foul on Jokic (DEN).
Jones (DEN) initiates lower-body contact with Alexander-Walker (ATL) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Daniels (ATL) commits a take foul on Jokic (DEN) after he receives the inbound.
Johnson (DEN) moves alongside Johnson (ATL), and Johnson (ATL) begins to stumble on his own before marginal contact occurs.
Murray (DEN) legally contests and gets his hand to the ball to block Alexander-Walker's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
